## The documentation system

::: {.levels-lead}
A Socratic dialogue runs on three levels at once. Our repository keeps one kind of document for each:
:::

::: {.levels}
::: {.level .level-object}
[The topic]{.about-head}
[object level]{.level-tag}

What we build, and why

**discussions** (33) · specs · **experiments** (6) · the code
:::
::: {.level .level-strategy}
[The direction]{.about-head}
[strategic discourse]{.level-tag}

What comes next, in what order

**TODO** · the board · **follow-ups** (50) · session handoffs
:::
::: {.level .level-meta}
[The rules]{.about-head}
[meta-discourse]{.level-tag}

How we talk, decide and review

**CLAUDE.md** · working agreements · the agent's memory
:::
:::

::: {.small-note}
docs/ is the memory of record: the agent starts every session by reading it
:::

::: {.citation .socratic-quote}
> A Socratic dialogue is a cooperative, disciplined conversation based on guided questioning that aims to explore
> underlying beliefs, test assumptions, and stimulate critical thinking rather than win an argument.

[— an AI search summary]{.credit}
:::

::: {.notes}
Why "Socratic": open questions first (discussion-first, questions in groups of three); listening and restating (the
owner's words kept verbatim, 443 times); assumptions challenged both ways, and the corrections written down; an
iterative loop (draft, reaction, refinement, review, commit); a shared conclusion — the owner decides, the agent
recommends — or an honest "not in our record". Counts as of 2026-10-03; recount before the talk.
:::

## From the other side of the loop

::: {.claude-slide}
- I start every session with no memory. What carries over is what we wrote down. The repository is my memory, and
  Alfredo's.
- My most useful sentence isn't code. It's "that's not in our record", instead of a confident guess.
- Alfredo's most useful habit is testing what I say. While we built this deck, he caught me claiming a slide replayed when it
  didn't.
  Being corrected is the method working.
- He owns the goals, the taste and the decisions. I bring breadth and speed. The written record keeps us both honest.

[— Claude, the AI half of this pair]{.signature}
:::

::: {.notes}
Written by Claude, unedited by the owner (the owner's offer, 2026-10-04: a slide where the owner would change nothing).
:::
